glosses: To depart on or in a vehicle, usually dramatically or loudly with engine noises.

examples.text: I rushed off a letter, warning them that I would be arriving the next day.

examples.text: Mais la Guerliche ne l’attendit point, et, préférant le soleil à l’ombre, il jugea prudent de décamper et ne reparut plus à Erchin.

glosses: To remove something by, or as if by, sweeping.

examples.text: Bridges were swept away or damaged on the Gifford and Lauder branches, both of which were closed to passengers several years ago, but remained open for goods traffic.

glosses: To overwhelm someone emotionally; sweep someone off their feet.

examples.text: Balaam was swept away with admiration of the Israelite encampments and homes that were a picture of idyllic happiness and prosperity.
